system.story: The bench specialist - the premier gear-mod crafter and field-repair savant.

description.value:
Subclass: Fabricator - the Gunsmith/Builder. The bench specialist: the premier gear-mod crafter, turret-layer, and field-repair savant. Fields fewer machines but the best-built ones, and shines in downtime.

Role Feature - Master Workshop

You gain extra mod slots and an edge on gear-mod/repair project rolls, and your Field Repair restores more and can rebuild wrecks faster.

Signature Tweak

Deploy the Line raises sturdier turrets (extra Integrity) and can be pre-built during downtime for a discount.

Bonus Skill & Contact

A crafting / Security-Systems bench skill, plus a parts-supplier or corp-quartermaster contact.

Chrome Flavor

A builder's rig with fabrication/diagnostic implants rather than deep Jump-In.
